title: I See It
skill_description: Blend 2 sounds, read patterned sentences with CV and VC words.
author: FunBookies
summary: A repetitive pattern book using the frame 'I see the ___' to practice CV and VC word patterns.
targetPhonics: CV patterns (ma, so) and VC patterns (am, at, it) with letters M, S, A, T, O, I, L, C

pages.scene: A child with binoculars looking at various animals. Warm watercolor style.
A friendly cat sitting and looking at the viewer.
A colorful mat on the floor.
A cat sitting down on the floor.
A child pointing at the cat on the mat.
The cat sitting comfortably on the mat.
A child smiling and watching the cat.
The cat curled up happily on the mat.
A child sitting next to the cat, both happy.
A child and cat together on the mat, cozy scene.

metadata.letterConstraints: M, S, A, T, O, I, L, C
metadata.caseConstraint: Sentence-initial caps, lowercase for known letters
